title: wire fan-out output (the 'output' of a capability bound with mode fanout)
description: What POST /v1/call returns as 'output' for a capability whose binding has mode fanout: one entry per source, in configured order. 'source' is an opaque label (its position, as text), never a core id. Each entry has exactly one of 'output' (checked against the capability's own output schema) or 'error' (a code the capability's contract allows, or a generic one). 'Exactly one' is enforced by the transport, not by this schema subset.
